site.name: Scrollosaurus
site.description: Explore dinosaurs on an interactive, zoomable timeline of the Mesozoic.
site.title: Scrollosaurus: dinosaurs on a timeline of the Mesozoic

timeline.helpPointer: Drag, or scroll with a mouse wheel or trackpad, to move through time. Pinch, or hold Ctrl and scroll, to zoom. Drag across the time axis, or hold Alt and scroll, to see more lanes.
timeline.helpTouch: On touch screens, drag to move and pinch to zoom.
timeline.helpKeyboard: Keyboard: focus the timeline, then use the arrow keys to move (hold Shift for bigger steps), + and − to zoom, and Home or End for the oldest or newest end. Tab moves through the species in view, oldest first; Enter or Space selects one.
timeline.boundariesInView: Boundaries in view, million years ago:
timeline.legend: Before each name: what it ate, then its body shape.

credits.title: Credits
credits.dataNote: Every species fact links to its sources in that species’ details. Data comes mainly from peer-reviewed papers, museums and the Paleobiology Database.
credits.imagesNote: All images come from Wikimedia Commons, under the licence shown with each one. For this site they are resized, converted to AVIF and WebP, and placed on a dark background where the original is transparent. The licence of each original applies to its copies.
credits.without: No suitable freely licensed image yet for:

about.title: About
about.p1: Scrollosaurus places dinosaurs on a timeline of the Mesozoic by the first and last time they appear in the fossil record. Every fact has a source, and every image has a free licence and a credit.
about.p2: Geological time boundaries follow the International Chronostratigraphic Chart of the International Commission on Stratigraphy.
